newsitem.title: PERU: 17 dead, 40 injured in Peru minibus crash.
newsitem.headline: 17 dead, 40 injured in Peru minibus crash.

text.p: Seventeen people died and 40 more were injured when two minibuses collided on a main highway in the north of Peru, officials said on Monday.
The crash occurred late Sunday at Milagros, or Miracle, on the Pacific coast between the towns of Chiclayo and Trujillo, 340 miles (550 km) north of Lima, firefighters said.
Swerving to avoid a car, one bus careened across the centre of the highway into the path of oncoming traffic where it smashed into another bus, local media reported.
The collision followed another accident Friday, when 23 people died and up to 50 were injured after a crowded bus overturned on Peru's high plains between the tourist towns of Cusco and Nasca.

The frequency of road accidents in Peru, where most people travel along poorly maintained highways on buses that are often overloaded, has led pressure groups to call for an overhaul of the country's transport regulations.
